description: With force_proceed set, missing required facts are written as UNOBTAINABLE_OWNER_CONFIRMED, the matter classifies, and the gap stays loudly on the record.
why_it_exists: A required fact can be genuinely unobtainable, and without an escape hatch the matter deadlocks. The escape hatch records an owner declaration, never a verified finding.

input.facts_json: {"incident_description": "Rear quarter panel struck while the vehicle was parked and unattended.", "incident_location": "Level 2, Hay Street car park, Perth WA", "owner_present": "no", "driver_identity": "vehicle was unattended", "registration": "9XYZ876", "incident_date": "2026-08-14", "incident_time": "09:20", "damage": "Dent and paint transfer to the rear quarter panel."}

items.facts_json: {"incident_description": "Rear quarter panel struck while the vehicle was parked and unattended.", "incident_location": "Level 2, Hay Street car park, Perth WA", "owner_present": "no", "driver_identity": "vehicle was unattended", "registration": "9XYZ876", "incident_date": "2026-08-14", "incident_time": "09:20", "damage": "Dent and paint transfer to the rear quarter panel."}

assertions: force_proceed is accepted as the boolean true or as the case-insensitive string 'true'.
A required fact that already has a real value is never overwritten with the unobtainable marker.
UNOBTAINABLE_OWNER_CONFIRMED is itself in the placeholder set, so it can never later be mistaken for a real value.
requires_human_review is forced true and REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW is always added on the forced path.
The owner summary states in plain words that the facts are the owner's declaration, are not verified findings, and that every document shows the gap.
Forcing with nothing actually missing produces a summary saying so and marks nothing as unobtainable.
When the record also holds off-vocabulary facts, one of them may be the very fact just declared unobtainable, so REQUIRED_FACT_MAY_BE_MISKEYED is raised again on the forced path.
